title: boronia hirsuta
intro: Boronia hirsuta, commonly known as the hairy boronia or hairy brown boronia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Boronia hirsuta include wound healing, skin protection, and the reduction of oxidative stress. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
